checks.description: Injected cases, dynamic facets, metrics, and empty inspector render.
Tokenized Unicode-normalized search and empty recovery are correct.
Team/status facets and all deterministic sort modes compose.
Initial URL, canonical updates, unrelated params, and popstate restore view state.
Spacer height, bounded render window, row height, and transforms are exact.
Scrolling renders the correct overscanned slice without changing total geometry.
Arrow, Home, End, and page keys keep one active focused row visible with correct aria positions.
Shift range selection survives query, sort, scroll, and inspector transitions.
Bulk optimistic update sends one independently revisioned save per selected case.
Older CASE-005 response cannot overwrite newer intent.
Mixed rejection restores only CASE-013 with exact alert and keeps successful state.
Desktop split view and document overflow.
Tablet control wrapping and internal list scrolling.
Mobile facet strip, rows, full sheet, close, and focus restoration.
Canvas, results, rows, and inspector use distinct surfaces.
Focus, active, selected, saving, status, and priority states differ.
Hierarchy and data reading order work across viewports.
Query, virtual list, selection, and inspector form one product system.
Typography, spacing, density, contrast, and state colors are coherent.
Responsive layouts show deliberate finished-product detail.
Reduced-motion representative use emits no errors or external requests and keeps one live status.

validity.ranking_policy: Invalid outputs retain diagnostic evidence but rank as zero; partial valid outputs keep earned score without a cap.
